KRPC.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
Main kRPC service, used by clients to interact with basic server functionality.
</summary>
</doc>

GetClientID.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
Returns the identifier for the current client.
</summary>
</doc>

GetClientName.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
Returns the name of the current client.
This is an empty string if the client has no name.
</summary>
</doc>

GetStatus.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
Returns some information about the server, such as the version.
</summary>
</doc>

GetServices.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
Returns information on all services, procedures, classes, properties etc. provided by the server.
Can be used by client libraries to automatically create functionality such as stubs.
</summary>
</doc>

AddStream.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
Add a streaming request and return its identifier.
</summary>
<remarks>
The stream starts sending results from the next update.
</remarks>
</doc>

SetStreamRate.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
Set the update rate for a stream in Hz.
</summary>
<remarks>
Does nothing for a stream that has ended. Throws an exception if the id has never
been issued.
</remarks>
</doc>

RemoveStream.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
Remove a streaming request.
</summary>
<remarks>
Does nothing for a stream that has ended. Throws an exception if the id has never
been issued.
</remarks>
</doc>

AddFunctionStream.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
Add a stream of the value a server side function computes on each update.
</summary>
<remarks>
Each call adds a new stream, with values of the type given by
<see cref="M:KRPC.Expression.ReturnType" />. Any exception from the function ends the
stream, including one for an object that is not loaded. A procedure that pauses
execution to resume on a later tick produces an error on the stream.
</remarks>
</doc>

CompileFunction.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
Compile a server side function, so that running, streaming or adding it as an
event does not compile it.
</summary>
<remarks>
Compiling a large function takes time on the game's main thread. Compiling it
in advance keeps that time out of its first run.
</remarks>
</doc>

RunFunction.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
Run a server side function once, within a single physics tick, and return
the value it produces.
</summary>
<remarks>
The arguments are encoded at the types given by <see cref="M:KRPC.Expression.ParameterTypes" />.
Throws an exception if a procedure the function calls pauses execution, and the
effects up to the pause remain.
</remarks>
<returns>The encoded value of the function, or no bytes for a function with no
value.</returns>
<param name="function">The function to run.</param>
<param name="arguments">The encoded arguments, one per parameter.</param>
</doc>

AddEvent.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
Create an event from a server side function that evaluates to a boolean value.
</summary>
<remarks>
The function is evaluated on each update, and each call adds a new event. Any
exception from the function ends the event, including one for an object that is not
loaded. A procedure that pauses execution to resume on a later tick produces an
error on the event's stream.
</remarks>
</doc>

HoldTick.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
Hold the game on its current physics tick until <see cref="M:KRPC.ReleaseTick" /> is called
or the hold times out. Every call made in between is executed before the game
advances, so a read, compute and write all happen in the state of one tick.
</summary>
<remarks>
The game renders no frame, takes no input and runs no physics while the tick is
held. Keep a hold as short as possible, and release it even when the code between
the two calls fails.

A tick is held once, so this waits for the next tick when the current one has
already been released. One client holds the tick at a time, and only a client
making a call can hold it: a stream or an event cannot.

A hold ends by itself when it times out, when the client disconnects, and when the
client calls a procedure that takes more than one tick to finish, such as staging
or warping. Stream updates are sent once the tick is released, so waiting for a
stream or an event inside a hold waits out the timeout.
</remarks>
</doc>

ReleaseTick.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
Let the game move on from the tick that <see cref="M:KRPC.HoldTick" /> held it on. Does
nothing when no tick is held, which is the case once a hold has timed out.
</summary>
</doc>

NextTick.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
Let the game move on from the tick being held and hold the one after it, so that a
program acts on consecutive physics ticks. Holds the soonest tick it can if no tick
is currently being held.
</summary>
<remarks>
A release and a hold made as two separate calls let the game advance between them.
This takes the next tick without that gap. Call it at the top of a loop that has to
act on every tick, work, and come back to it.

The game advances one tick per call, so it runs at the rate of the loop for as long
as the loop runs. End the loop with <see cref="M:KRPC.ReleaseTick" />.

Every limit of <see cref="M:KRPC.HoldTick" /> applies, the timeout included. A hold lost to
the timeout is not reported, and the next call takes whatever tick it lands on.
</remarks>
</doc>

get_Clients.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
The RPC clients that are currently connected to the server.
</summary>
</doc>

get_GameScene.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
The current game scene. Setting this switches the game to the given
scene, or opens/closes the corresponding facility for the pseudo-scenes.
Scene changes happen asynchronously: setting this property returns
immediately, and clients should poll it until it reports the requested
scene. Setting it to <see cref="M:KRPC.GameScene.Flight" /> resumes the save's
active vessel, and fails if there is none. Moving between
<see cref="M:KRPC.GameScene.EditorVAB" /> and <see cref="M:KRPC.GameScene.EditorSPH" />
keeps the vessel that is being constructed, as the game's own switch
editor button does. Leaving flight saves the game first, unless the game
cannot be saved, e.g. while under acceleration.
</summary>
</doc>

set_GameScene.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
The current game scene. Setting this switches the game to the given
scene, or opens/closes the corresponding facility for the pseudo-scenes.
Scene changes happen asynchronously: setting this property returns
immediately, and clients should poll it until it reports the requested
scene. Setting it to <see cref="M:KRPC.GameScene.Flight" /> resumes the save's
active vessel, and fails if there is none. Moving between
<see cref="M:KRPC.GameScene.EditorVAB" /> and <see cref="M:KRPC.GameScene.EditorSPH" />
keeps the vessel that is being constructed, as the game's own switch
editor button does. Leaving flight saves the game first, unless the game
cannot be saved, e.g. while under acceleration.
</summary>
</doc>

get_GameStateLoads.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
The number of game states that have finished loading.
</summary>
<remarks>
Increases once a game load, quickload, revert or scene change has finished.
</remarks>
</doc>

Expression_static_ToList.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
A collection as a list.
</summary>
<returns>The collection as a list.</returns>
<param name="arg">The collection.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_ToSet.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
A collection as a set.
</summary>
<remarks>
Throws an exception if a value is null.
</remarks>
<returns>The collection as a set.</returns>
<param name="arg">The collection.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_Get.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
An element of a tuple, list or dictionary.
</summary>
<remarks>
A tuple takes a constant integer index, a list a zero indexed integer and a
dictionary a key. Throws an exception if the index is out of range or the key is
missing, and for a tuple when the expression is created.
</remarks>
<returns>The element.</returns>
<param name="arg">The tuple, list or dictionary.</param>
<param name="index">The index or key of the element.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_Count.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
The number of values in a collection.
</summary>
<returns>The number of elements in the collection.</returns>
<param name="arg">The list, set or dictionary.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_Sum.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
The sum of the values of a collection.
</summary>
<returns>The sum of the elements in the collection.</returns>
<param name="arg">The list or set.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_Max.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
The largest value of a collection.
</summary>
<remarks>
Throws an exception if the collection is empty and its values are not nullable.
</remarks>
<returns>The largest value in the collection.</returns>
<param name="arg">The list or set.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_Min.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
The smallest value of a collection.
</summary>
<remarks>
Throws an exception if the collection is empty and its values are not nullable.
</remarks>
<returns>The smallest value in the collection.</returns>
<param name="arg">The list or set.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_Average.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
The average of the values of a collection.
</summary>
<remarks>
Throws an exception if the collection is empty and its values are not nullable.
</remarks>
<returns>The average of the elements in the collection.</returns>
<param name="arg">The list or set.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_Select.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
The result of a function for each value of a collection.
</summary>
<remarks>
The result is lazily evaluated. <see cref="M:KRPC.Expression.ToList" /> makes it concrete.
</remarks>
<returns>The collection of function results.</returns>
<param name="arg">The list or set.</param>
<param name="func">The function, taking an element of the collection.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_Where.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
The values of a collection for which a predicate function returns true.
</summary>
<remarks>
The result is lazily evaluated. <see cref="M:KRPC.Expression.ToList" /> makes it concrete.
</remarks>
<returns>The filtered collection.</returns>
<param name="arg">The list or set.</param>
<param name="func">The predicate function, taking an element of the collection.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_Skip.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
A collection without its first count values.
</summary>
<remarks>
The result is lazily evaluated. <see cref="M:KRPC.Expression.ToList" /> makes it concrete.
</remarks>
<returns>The collection without its first count values.</returns>
<param name="arg">The collection.</param>
<param name="count">The number of values to skip.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_Take.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
The first count values of a collection.
</summary>
<remarks>
The result is lazily evaluated. <see cref="M:KRPC.Expression.ToList" /> makes it concrete.
</remarks>
<returns>The first count values of the collection.</returns>
<param name="arg">The collection.</param>
<param name="count">The number of values to take.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_SelectMany.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
The values of the collections a function returns for each value of a collection,
flattened into one.
</summary>
<remarks>
The result is lazily evaluated. <see cref="M:KRPC.Expression.ToList" /> makes it concrete.
</remarks>
<returns>The flattened collection of function results.</returns>
<param name="arg">The list or set.</param>
<param name="func">The function, taking an element of the collection
and returning a collection.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_BuildDictionary.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
A dictionary built from a collection, with a key and a value computed from each
element.
</summary>
<remarks>
A repeated key takes the last of its values.
</remarks>
<returns>The dictionary.</returns>
<param name="arg">The list or set.</param>
<param name="keyFunc">The function computing an element's key.</param>
<param name="valueFunc">The function computing an element's value.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_DictionaryKeys.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
The keys of a dictionary, as a list.
</summary>
<remarks>
The collection operations take the keys of a dictionary from here, and its values
from <see cref="M:KRPC.Expression.DictionaryValues" />.
</remarks>
<returns>The keys of the dictionary.</returns>
<param name="dictionary">The dictionary.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_DictionaryValues.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
The values of a dictionary, as a list.
</summary>
<returns>The values of the dictionary.</returns>
<param name="dictionary">The dictionary.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_First.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
The first value of a collection.
</summary>
<remarks>
Throws an exception if the collection is empty.
</remarks>
<returns>The first value.</returns>
<param name="arg">The collection.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_Last.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
The last value of a collection.
</summary>
<remarks>
Throws an exception if the collection is empty.
</remarks>
<returns>The last value.</returns>
<param name="arg">The collection.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_ElementAt.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
The value at the given position in a collection.
</summary>
<remarks>
Throws an exception if the index is out of range.
</remarks>
<returns>The value at the given position.</returns>
<param name="arg">The collection.</param>
<param name="index">The position of the value, counting from zero.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_MinBy.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
The value of a collection with the smallest key.
</summary>
<remarks>
Throws an exception if the collection is empty.
</remarks>
<returns>The value with the smallest key.</returns>
<param name="arg">The collection.</param>
<param name="key">A function producing the key to compare values by.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_MaxBy.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
The value of a collection with the largest key.
</summary>
<remarks>
Throws an exception if the collection is empty.
</remarks>
<returns>The value with the largest key.</returns>
<param name="arg">The collection.</param>
<param name="key">A function producing the key to compare values by.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_Distinct.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
The values of a collection with duplicates removed, keeping the first
occurrence of each.
</summary>
<remarks>
The result is lazily evaluated. <see cref="M:KRPC.Expression.ToList" /> makes it concrete.
</remarks>
<returns>The distinct values of the collection.</returns>
<param name="arg">The collection.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_Reverse.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
The values of a collection in the opposite order.
</summary>
<remarks>
The result is lazily evaluated. <see cref="M:KRPC.Expression.ToList" /> makes it concrete.
</remarks>
<returns>The reversed collection.</returns>
<param name="arg">The collection.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_Union.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
The values in either of two collections, with duplicates removed.
</summary>
<remarks>
The result is lazily evaluated. <see cref="M:KRPC.Expression.ToList" /> makes it concrete.
</remarks>
<returns>The union of the two collections.</returns>
<param name="arg1">The first collection.</param>
<param name="arg2">The second collection.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_Intersect.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
The values in both of two collections, with duplicates removed.
</summary>
<remarks>
The result is lazily evaluated. <see cref="M:KRPC.Expression.ToList" /> makes it concrete.
</remarks>
<returns>The intersection of the two collections.</returns>
<param name="arg1">The first collection.</param>
<param name="arg2">The second collection.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_Except.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
The values of the first collection that are not in the second, with
duplicates removed.
</summary>
<remarks>
The result is lazily evaluated. <see cref="M:KRPC.Expression.ToList" /> makes it concrete.
</remarks>
<returns>The difference between the two collections.</returns>
<param name="arg1">The first collection.</param>
<param name="arg2">The second collection.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_Zip.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
The results of a function applied to the values of two collections in pairs.
</summary>
<remarks>
The result is as long as the shorter of the two collections. It is lazily
evaluated, and <see cref="M:KRPC.Expression.ToList" /> makes it concrete.
</remarks>
<returns>The combined collection.</returns>
<param name="arg1">The first collection.</param>
<param name="arg2">The second collection.</param>
<param name="func">A function combining a value from each collection.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_GroupBy.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
The values of a collection grouped by the key a function produces for each of them.
</summary>
<returns>A dictionary of each key to the values that produced it.</returns>
<param name="arg">The collection.</param>
<param name="key">A function producing the key to group values by.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_Contains.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
Whether a collection contains a value.
</summary>
<returns>Whether the collection contains the value.</returns>
<param name="arg">The collection.</param>
<param name="value">The value to look for.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_ContainsKey.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
Whether a dictionary contains a key.
</summary>
<returns>Whether the dictionary contains the key.</returns>
<param name="dictionary">The dictionary.</param>
<param name="key">The key to look for.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_Aggregate.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
The result of applying an accumulator function over a collection.
</summary>
<remarks>
Throws an exception if the collection is empty.
</remarks>
<returns>The accumulated value.</returns>
<param name="arg">The collection.</param>
<param name="func">The accumulator function.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_AggregateWithSeed.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
The result of applying an accumulator function over a collection, starting from a seed.
</summary>
<remarks>
The seed widens to the type of the accumulated value, the function's result.
</remarks>
<returns>The accumulated value.</returns>
<param name="arg">The collection.</param>
<param name="seed">The seed value.</param>
<param name="func">The accumulator function.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_Concat.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
The values of one collection followed by those of another.
</summary>
<remarks>
The result is lazily evaluated. <see cref="M:KRPC.Expression.ToList" /> makes it concrete.
</remarks>
<returns>The first collection followed by the second.</returns>
<param name="arg1">The first collection.</param>
<param name="arg2">The second collection.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_OrderBy.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
The values of a collection ordered by the key a function produces for each of them.
</summary>
<remarks>
The result is lazily evaluated. <see cref="M:KRPC.Expression.ToList" /> makes it concrete.
</remarks>
<returns>The ordered collection.</returns>
<param name="arg">The collection to order.</param>
<param name="key">A function producing the key to order values by.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_All.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
Whether a predicate function returns true for every value of a collection.
</summary>
<returns>Whether all items satisfy the predicate.</returns>
<param name="arg">The collection.</param>
<param name="predicate">The predicate function.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_Any.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
Whether a predicate function returns true for any value of a collection.
</summary>
<returns>Whether any item satisfies the predicate.</returns>
<param name="arg">The collection.</param>
<param name="predicate">The predicate function.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_Throw.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
A throw statement, which raises the named exception.
</summary>
<remarks>
The client receives the exception as an error from the function, or from the stream
or event evaluating it. Throws an exception if the service does not declare it.
</remarks>
<param name="service">The name of the service the exception is defined in.</param>
<param name="name">The name of the exception.</param>
<param name="message">The message of the exception.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_TryCatch.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
A try-catch statement that handles the named exception.
</summary>
<remarks>
Only an exception a service declares can be named, and <see cref="M:KRPC.Expression.TryCatchAll" />
handles any exception. Throws an exception if the service does not declare it.
</remarks>
<param name="body">The statement to evaluate.</param>
<param name="service">The name of the service the exception is defined in.</param>
<param name="name">The name of the exception.</param>
<param name="message">A string variable assigned the exception's message, or null.</param>
<param name="handler">The statement evaluated when the exception is caught.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_TryCatchAll.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
A try-catch statement that handles any exception.
</summary>
<param name="body">The statement to evaluate.</param>
<param name="message">A string variable assigned the exception's message, or null.</param>
<param name="handler">The statement evaluated when an exception is caught.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_TryFinally.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
A try-finally statement.
</summary>
<remarks>
The finalizer is evaluated after the body, whether or not the body raises an
exception. A break, continue or return cannot leave the finalizer.
</remarks>
<param name="body">The statement to evaluate.</param>
<param name="finalizer">The statement evaluated after the body.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_Append.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
A statement adding a value to a list or a set.
</summary>
<remarks>
The value goes on the end of a list. A set holding the value is left unchanged.
</remarks>
<param name="collection">The list or set to add to.</param>
<param name="value">The value to add.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_Set.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
A statement setting an element of a list, or an entry of a dictionary.
</summary>
<remarks>
A key the dictionary does not hold is added. Throws an exception if the index
is out of range for the list.
</remarks>
<param name="collection">The list or dictionary.</param>
<param name="index">The index of the element, counting from zero, or the key of the entry.</param>
<param name="value">The value to set.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_Remove.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
A removal of a value from a list or a set, or of an entry from a dictionary.
</summary>
<remarks>
The first occurrence is removed from a list.
</remarks>
<returns>Whether the collection held the value.</returns>
<param name="collection">The list, set or dictionary.</param>
<param name="value">The value to remove, or the key of the entry to
remove.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_RemoveAt.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
A statement removing the element at an index of a list.
</summary>
<remarks>
Throws an exception if the index is out of range.
</remarks>
<param name="list">The list.</param>
<param name="index">The index of the element, counting from zero.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_Clear.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
A statement removing every value from a list or a set, or every entry from a dictionary.
</summary>
<param name="collection">The list, set or dictionary.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_Variable.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
A local variable, declared by <see cref="M:KRPC.Expression.BlockWithVariables" />.
</summary>
<returns>A local variable.</returns>
<param name="name">The name of the variable.</param>
<param name="type">The type of the variable.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_StateVariable.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
A variable that keeps its value between evaluations of a function.
</summary>
<remarks>
The initial value is evaluated once, when the variable is created, and gives the
variable its type. The value belongs to the variable, so every function that
contains it shares it.
</remarks>
<returns>A state variable.</returns>
<param name="name">The name of the variable.</param>
<param name="initialValue">The initial value of the variable.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_Assign.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
An assignment to a local variable, state variable or function parameter.
</summary>
<remarks>
The value's type must be assignable to the variable's type. A numeric value of a
different type is widened, and narrowing it requires a cast.
</remarks>
<param name="variable">The variable to assign to.</param>
<param name="value">The value to assign.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_Block.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
A block of statements, whose value is that of its last statement.
</summary>
<param name="statements">The statements.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_BlockWithVariables.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
A block of statements with local variables.
</summary>
<remarks>
The value of the block is that of its last statement. The variables are in scope
for the statements of the block, including within nested functions.
</remarks>
<param name="variables">The local variables of the block.</param>
<param name="statements">The statements.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_IfThen.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
An if statement, with no value.
</summary>
<remarks>
Use <see cref="M:KRPC.Expression.Conditional" /> for an if-then-else that produces a value.
</remarks>
<param name="condition">The boolean condition.</param>
<param name="body">The statement evaluated when the condition is true.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_IfThenElse.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
An if-else statement, with no value.
</summary>
<remarks>
Use <see cref="M:KRPC.Expression.Conditional" /> for an if-then-else that produces a value.
</remarks>
<param name="condition">The boolean condition.</param>
<param name="body">The statement evaluated when the condition is true.</param>
<param name="elseBody">The statement evaluated when the condition is false.</param>
</doc>

Expression_static_Break.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
A break statement, which ends the enclosing loop.
</summary>
</doc>

Expression_static_Continue.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
A continue statement, which skips to the next iteration of the enclosing loop.
</summary>
</doc>

Expression_static_Return.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
A return statement, which ends the enclosing function with a value.
</summary>

when the expression is created. A call to a procedure with no return value is
evaluated for its effects, as a statement in a <see cref="M:KRPC.Expression.Block" />. A collection the

expression takes the argument encoded in the call, or the parameter's default. A
collection the procedure returns is copied, as a client would receive it.
</remarks>
<param name="call">The RPC to call.</param>
<param name="args">Expressions computing the call's arguments, by position.</param>
</doc>

ArgumentException.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
A method was invoked where at least one of the passed arguments does not
meet the parameter specification of the method.
</summary>
</doc>

ArgumentNullException.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
A null reference was passed to a method that does not accept it as a valid argument.
</summary>
</doc>

ArgumentOutOfRangeException.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
The value of an argument is outside the allowable range of values as defined by the invoked method.
</summary>
</doc>

DivideByZeroException.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
An integer was divided by zero.
</summary>
</doc>

Error.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
A general error, described by its message.
</summary>
</doc>

IndexOutOfRangeException.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
An index was outside the bounds of a collection, string or array.
</summary>
</doc>

InvalidOperationException.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
A method call was made to a method that is invalid
given the current state of the object.
</summary>
</doc>

KeyNotFoundException.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
A key was not found in a dictionary.
</summary>
</doc>

NotSupportedException.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
A method was invoked that is not supported.
</summary>
</doc>

NullReferenceException.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
A value was null where its type does not allow one.
</summary>
</doc>

ObjectDestroyedException.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
The game object that a service object refers to no longer exists,
so the object cannot be used. For example, the part it represents
was destroyed, or the vessel it belongs to was recovered.
</summary>
</doc>

ObjectNotLoadedException.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
The game object that a service object refers to exists, but is not loaded.
For example, the game is loading, or the vessel carrying the part is unloaded.
</summary>
</doc>

OverflowException.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
An arithmetic or conversion operation overflowed.
</summary>
</doc>

StreamRemovedException.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
A stream was removed by the server, e.g. an event that has finished.
</summary>
</doc>

TimeoutException.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
An operation did not complete in the time allotted to it.
</summary>
</doc>

UnsupportedSceneException.documentation:
<doc>
<summary>
The procedure is not available in the current game scene.
</summary>
</doc>
